1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “The Lord roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers.”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “For three sins of Damascus, even for four, I will not relent. Because she threshed Gilead with sledges having iron teeth,

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will send fire on the house of Hazael that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir,”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “For three sins of Gaza, even for four, I will not relent. Because she took captive whole communities and sold them to Edom,

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will send fire on the walls of Gaza that will consume her fortresses.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines are dead,”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “For three sins of Tyre, even for four, I will not relent. Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom, disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will send fire on the walls of Tyre that will consume her fortresses.”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not relent. Because he pursued his brother with a sword and slaughtered the women of the land, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will send fire on Teman that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah.”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “For three sins of Ammon, even for four, I will not relent. Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend his borders,

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah that will consume her fortresses amid war cries on the day of battle, amid violent winds on a stormy day.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: Her king will go into exile, he and his officials together,”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not relent. Because he burned to ashes the bones of Edom`s king,

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will send fire on Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him,”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not relent. Because they have rejected the law of the Lord and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will send fire on Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem.”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not relent. They sell the innocent for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them, though they were tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I brought you up out of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to give you the land of the Amorites.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “I also raised up prophets from among your children and Nazirites from among your youths. Is this not true, people of Israel?”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day,”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins.”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people.”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “They do not know how to do right,”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “who store up in their fortresses what they have plundered and looted.”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “An enemy will overrun your land, pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses.”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “As a shepherd rescues from the lion`s mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued, with only the head of a bed and a piece of fabric from a couch.”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob,”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: You will each go straight out through breaches in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings— boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, destroying them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me,”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, Israel, prepare to meet your God.”

5.speaker: amos
5.quote: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up.”

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: “Your city that marches out a thousand strong will have only a hundred left; your town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left.”

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing.”

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: “There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,”

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: “I hate, I despise your religious festivals; your assemblies are a stench to me.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: “Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god— which you made for yourselves.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,”

6.speaker: the-lord
6.quote: “I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”

6.speaker: israel
6.quote: “Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord.”

6.speaker: israel
6.quote: “Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?”

6.speaker: the-lord
6.quote: “I will stir up a nation against you, Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah.”

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: “Sovereign Lord, forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: “Sovereign Lord, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

7.speaker: the-lord
7.quote: “Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

7.speaker: the-lord
7.quote: “The high places of Isaac will be destroyed and the sanctuaries of Israel will be ruined; with my sword I will rise against the house of Jeroboam.”

7.speaker: amaziah
7.quote: “Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.

7.speaker: amaziah
7.quote: For this is what Amos is saying: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.’”

7.speaker: amaziah
7.quote: “Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

7.speaker: amaziah
7.quote: Don`t prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king`s sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom.”

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: “I was neither a prophet nor the son of a prophet, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: But the Lord took me from tending the flock and said to me,

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: Now then, hear the word of the Lord. You say,

7.speaker: amaziah
7.quote: 'Do not prophesy against Israel, and stop preaching against the descendants of Isaac.'

7.speaker: amos
7.quote: Therefore this is what the Lord says:

7.speaker: the-lord
7.quote: 'Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a pagan country. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.'

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies—flung everywhere! Silence!”

8.speaker: israel
8.quote: “When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?”

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “I will never forget anything they have done.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: I will turn your religious festivals into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: “when I will send a famine through the land— not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the Lord.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the Lord, but they will not find it.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: In that day the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria— who say,

8.speaker: israel
8.quote: 'As surely as your god lives, Dan,' or, 'As surely as the god of Beersheba lives'

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: — they will fall, never to rise again.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: Though they dig down to the depths below, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens above, from there I will bring them down.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good.”

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites?”

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “Surely the eyes of the Sovereign Lord are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not totally destroy the descendants of Jacob,”

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “In that day I will restore David`s fallen shelter— I will repair its broken walls and restore its ruins— and will rebuild it as it used to be,

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name,”

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: “when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills,

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: and I will bring my people Israel back from exile. They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them,”
